notes.title: Live on Kickstarter!
notes.content:
We are so thrilled to announce Fallen Fates is now live on Kickstarter



The big day is here 🥰

We put all our heart in this campaign and we hope you’ll feel it too!!



We tried to put as many details about the game as we could and we took much pleasure to do so!


New Trailer
For the occasion we prepared a 2 minutes long trailer including traditional cinematics made by Sapin Sympa collective. It will also feature a lot of new in-game content to depict better what the game aims to look like.
[previewyoutube="SzmrRiz65cc;full"][/previewyoutube]
And…this trailer is voiced! We didn’t announce it much yet but Ben Starr will be voicing Arven!!!

We’re thrilled to have him on board and his voice gives so much depth and life to Arven, we love it! 😄

Six One Indie showcase
In addition to the Kickstarter trailer, we’ll be live at Six One Indie showcase with another trailer! 

Showcase will be aired at 6PM CEST: 
[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QncfsZr_fxQ"][/dynamiclink]Early Birds
We said in our previous newsletter that your support was important, and early backers have a huge impact on a Kickstarter success too.

That’s why you’ll find 3 Early Birds tiers:

2 of them are a discount on a digital tiers and a physical tiers

The 3rd one is a premium tiers in which you’ll also have a figure of Ayla’s from Astral Ascent for the same price.



We have planned many amazing digital and physical rewards!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637285/9d5acb62992029ed6765a0516d13a140d0464681.png"]



Thank you for being around from the start of this exciting new journey and we hope you will love this game we are crafting as much as we do!

- The Hibernian Workshop Team
